private ByteString readJsonString (boolean skipContext) throws IOException

- It creates a Buffer buffer = new Buffer();
- ArrayList<Character> codeunits = new ArrayList<>();
- If !skipContext: context.read();
- readJsonSyntaxChar(QUOTE); // read opening quote
- while true:
    - byte ch = reader.read();
    - if ch == QUOTE[0] break; // closing quote
    - if ch == ESCSEQ[0] (escape sequence start):
        - ch = reader.read();
        - if ch == ESCSEQ[1] (likely 'u' for unicode escape):
            - read 4 hex digits into tmpbuf
            - compute short cu = hexVal(tmpbuf[0])<<12 + ... etc
            - try:
                - if Character.isHighSurrogate((char)cu):
                    - if codeunits.size()>0 throw ProtocolException
                    - codeunits.add((char)cu)
                - else if Character.isLowSurrogate((char)cu):
                    - if codeunits.size()==0 throw ProtocolException
                    - codeunits.add((char)cu)
                    - buffer.write(new String(new int[]{codeunits.get(0), codeunits.get(1)},0,2).getBytes("UTF-8"));
                    - codeunits.clear()
                - else:
                    - buffer.write(new String(new int[]{cu},0,1).getBytes("UTF-8"));
                - continue
            - catch UnsupportedEncodingException: throw AssertionError
            - catch IOException: throw ProtocolException
        - else:
            - int off = ESCAPE_CHARS.indexOf(ch);
            - if off == -1 throw ProtocolException
            - ch = ESCAPE_CHAR_VALS[off];
    - buffer.write(new byte[]{ch});
- return buffer.readByteString();
